units.title: Unit 1 Have You Had Breakfast Yet?

q.q: eat 的過去分詞是哪一個？
q.e: eat 是不規則動詞：eat－ate－eaten。

q.q: go 的過去分詞是哪一個？
q.e: go－went－gone。

q.q: write 的過去分詞是哪一個？
q.e: write－wrote－written。

q.q: see 的過去分詞是哪一個？
q.e: see－saw－seen。

q.q: hear 的過去分詞是哪一個？
q.e: hear－heard－heard，過去式和過去分詞同形。

q.q: 下列哪一組「原形－過去式－過去分詞」是正確的？
q.e: take 的過去式是 took，過去分詞是 taken。

q.q: 現在完成式的基本句型是什麼？
q.e: 現在完成式＝have／has＋p.p.，主詞是第三人稱單數用 has。

q.q: She ＿＿ been to Japan twice.
q.e: 主詞 She 是第三人稱單數，用 has＋過去分詞。

q.q: ＿＿ you ever tried stinky tofu?
q.e: 問經驗用 Have you ever＋p.p.? 主詞 you 搭配 Have。

q.q: I have ＿＿ seen a whale. It is my dream.
q.e: never 表示「從來沒有」，放在 have 和過去分詞中間。

q.q: 「我看過這部電影三次。」英文怎麼說？
o: I have seen this movie three times.
I have see this movie three times.
I seen this movie three times.
I am seeing this movie three times.
q.e: 經驗次數用現在完成式：have＋seen＋次數。

q.q: —Has Tom ever been to Kenting? —Yes, he ＿＿.
q.e: 用 Has 問，就用 has 回答：Yes, he has.

q.q: 「我已經吃過早餐了。」英文怎麼說？
q.e: 肯定句用 already，放在 have 和過去分詞中間。

q.q: Have you finished your homework ＿＿?
q.e: 疑問句問「了嗎」用 yet，通常放在句尾。

q.q: I haven't cleaned my room ＿＿.
q.e: 否定句「還沒」用 not ... yet。

q.q: —Has the bus left yet? —No, it ＿＿.
q.e: 主詞 it 搭配 has，否定簡答是 No, it hasn't.

q.q: 下列哪一句是正確的？
o: He has already done the dishes.
He has already did the dishes.
He has yet done the dishes.
He already has do the dishes.
q.e: do 的過去分詞是 done，肯定句用 already。

q.q: 現在完成式「不能」和下列哪一個時間詞一起用？
q.e: yesterday 是明確的過去時間，要用過去式，不能用現在完成式。

q.q: They have lived in Taichung ＿＿ 2020.
q.e: since 後面接「從某個時間點開始」。

q.q: She has studied English ＿＿ six years.
q.e: for 後面接「一段時間」。

q.q: ＿＿ have you known Amy? —For three years.
q.e: 問持續多久用 How long＋have／has＋主詞＋p.p.?

q.q: I have been sick ＿＿ last Monday.
q.e: last Monday 是時間點，用 since。

q.q: 「他當老師已經十年了。」英文怎麼說？
o: He has been a teacher for ten years.
He is a teacher since ten years.
He has been a teacher since ten years.
He was a teacher for ten years ago.
q.e: 一段時間用 for，持續到現在用現在完成式。

q.q: 下列哪一個可以接在 since 後面？
q.e: since 後面可以接時間點，也可以接過去式子句，例如 since I was ten。

q.q: —Have you ever eaten durian? —No, I ＿＿.
q.e: 用 Have you ever 問，否定簡答 No, I haven't.

q.q: My grandpa has ＿＿ every morning since he retired.
q.e: has 後面要接過去分詞 exercised。

q.q: Mom ＿＿ the plants yet.
q.e: 否定句 hasn't＋過去分詞，yet 放句尾。

q.q: 「你曾經去過花蓮嗎？」英文怎麼說？
o: Have you ever been to Hualien?
Are you ever been to Hualien?
q.e: have been to 表示「曾經去過（並且回來了）」。

q.q: He has gone to the gym. 這句話的意思是什麼？
o: 他去健身房了（現在不在這裡）
q.e: have gone to 是「去了某地，人還在那裡」；have been to 是「去過」。

q.q: I ＿＿ my bike last Sunday.
q.e: last Sunday 是明確的過去時間，要用過去式 rode。

q.q: We have known each other ＿＿ we were in elementary school.
q.e: since 後面接過去式子句，表示「從那時起」。

q.q: 要保持健康，下列哪一個建議最合適？
q.e: 充足睡眠是保持健康的好習慣。

q.q: The movie was very ＿＿. Everyone laughed.
q.e: 形容「事物」帶給人的感覺用 -ing。

q.q: I am ＿＿ in science fiction movies.
q.e: 形容「人」的感受用 -ed：be interested in。

q.q: The long trip made us very ＿＿.
q.e: 「我們」覺得累，人的感受用 tired。

q.q: The news was ＿＿. Nobody expected it.
q.e: 消息本身「令人驚訝的」，用 surprising。

q.q: Ken felt ＿＿ because he lost the game.
q.e: Ken 自己感到失望，用 disappointed。

q.q: 下列哪一句是正確的？
o: The horror movie is scary, and I am frightened.
I am frightening by the movie.
The horror movie scared me, so I am frightening.
q.e: 電影「令人害怕的」用 scary／frightening；我「感到害怕」用 frightened。

q.q: The cake ＿＿ delicious.
q.e: 感官動詞 taste 後面直接接形容詞，主詞單數加 s。

q.q: You look ＿＿ today. Did you sleep well?
q.e: look（看起來）後面接形容詞。

q.q: This song sounds ＿＿ a lullaby.
q.e: 感官動詞後面接名詞時，要加 like。

q.q: The flower ＿＿ sweet.
q.e: smell＋形容詞：聞起來很香。

q.q: 「這部電影看起來很刺激。」英文怎麼說？
q.e: look＋形容詞，電影帶給人的感覺用 exciting。

q.q: The blanket feels ＿＿.
q.e: feel（摸起來）＋形容詞 soft。

q.q: He is old ＿＿ to drive a car.
q.e: 形容詞＋enough to＋原形動詞：夠……可以……。enough 放在形容詞後面。

q.q: The box is ＿＿ heavy for me to carry.
q.e: too＋形容詞＋to V：太……而不能……。

q.q: We have ＿＿ money to buy the tickets.
q.e: enough＋名詞：足夠的錢。enough 放在名詞前面。

q.q: 「我太累了，不能去看電影。」英文怎麼說？
o: I am too tired to go to the movies.
I am tired enough to go to the movies.
I am so tired to go to the movies.
I am too tired going to the movies.
q.e: too＋形容詞＋to＋原形動詞。

q.q: The water is warm ＿＿ for the baby to take a bath.
q.e: 夠溫暖，可以讓寶寶洗澡：warm enough。

q.q: The question is too hard ＿＿.
q.e: too＋形容詞＋for 人＋to＋原形動詞。

q.q: The movie was ＿＿ funny that we couldn't stop laughing.
q.e: so＋形容詞＋that＋子句：如此……以致於……。

q.q: He ran so fast ＿＿ he won the race.
q.e: so＋副詞＋that 子句，表示結果。

q.q: 「這本書太無聊了，我看到睡著。」用 so ... that 怎麼說？
o: The book was so boring that I fell asleep.
The book was so bored that I fell asleep.
The book was too boring that I fell asleep.
The book was so boring to I fell asleep.
q.e: so＋boring（令人無聊的）＋that＋子句。

q.q: The box is too heavy for me to carry. 改成 so ... that 的句子是哪一個？
o: The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
The box is so heavy that I can carry it.
The box is so heavy that I can't carry.
The box is heavy enough that I can carry it.
q.e: too ... to 有否定意思，改寫時要用 can't，並補上受詞 it。

q.q: It was so cold ＿＿ we stayed at home.
q.e: so cold that ...：天氣太冷，所以我們待在家。

q.q: She is so kind ＿＿ everyone likes her.
q.e: so＋形容詞＋that 引導結果子句。

q.q: What a ＿＿ ending! I cried a lot.
q.e: 形容結局「令人感動的」用 touching。

q.q: After watching the horror film, Amy was too ＿＿ to sleep.
q.e: Amy 自己「感到害怕」用 scared。

q.q: Is the theater big ＿＿ for 300 people?
q.e: big enough for ...：夠大，可以容納……。

q.q: —Do you want to see a movie with me tonight? —＿＿
q.e: sound＋形容詞 great；邀約時常用 That sounds great.

q.q: 看到一則「明星推薦，三天瘦十公斤」的網路廣告，最好怎麼做？
o: 先查證資訊的來源，不要馬上相信
q.e: 面對網路資訊要查證來源，分辨真假。

q.q: 在網路上下載電影時，下列哪一個做法尊重智慧財產權？
o: 使用正版授權的平台觀看
下載盜版電影分享給同學
把電影錄下來上傳到網路
q.e: 使用正版授權的管道，才是尊重創作者的智慧財產權。

q.q: This shirt is too small for me ＿＿.
q.e: too＋形容詞＋for 人＋to＋原形動詞。

q.q: 「我興奮到睡不著。」英文怎麼說？
o: I was so excited that I couldn't sleep.
I was so exciting that I couldn't sleep.
I was too excited that I couldn't sleep.
I was excited enough to not sleep.
q.e: 人感到興奮用 excited，so ... that 表示結果。

units.title: Unit 3 The Soldier Was Saved by a Dog

q.q: 被動語態的基本句型是什麼？
q.e: 被動語態＝be 動詞＋p.p.，表示主詞「被……」。

q.q: The window ＿＿ by Tom yesterday.
q.e: 昨天發生，用過去式 be 動詞 was＋過去分詞 broken。

q.q: English ＿＿ in many countries.
q.e: 英語「被說」，現在簡單式被動：is spoken。

q.q: These cookies ＿＿ by my grandma.
q.e: 主詞 cookies 是複數，用 were＋made。

q.q: 把 Many people love this song. 改成被動語態，哪一個正確？
o: This song is loved by many people.
This song loves by many people.
This song is love by many people.
Many people are loved by this song.
q.e: 受詞變主詞，動詞改成 is＋loved，原主詞放在 by 後面。

q.q: The soldier was saved ＿＿ a dog.
q.e: 被動語態中，做動作的人或動物放在 by 後面。

q.q: The bridge ＿＿ next year.
q.e: 未來式被動：will be＋過去分詞。

q.q: The homework must ＿＿ by Friday.
q.e: 助動詞＋be＋過去分詞：must be finished。

q.q: The museum ＿＿ in 1908.
q.e: 博物館「被建造」在過去，用 was built。

q.q: The house has ＿＿ for ten years.
q.e: 現在完成式被動：have／has been＋過去分詞。

q.q: Plastic bottles can ＿＿.
q.e: can＋be＋過去分詞：可以被回收。

q.q: A lot of trees ＿＿ by the typhoon last week.
q.e: 上週發生、主詞複數：were＋blown down。

q.q: The letter ＿＿ by Mary.
q.e: 信「被寫」，用被動 was written。

q.q: Mary ＿＿ a letter to her grandma.
q.e: Mary 主動寫信，用主動語態 wrote。

q.q: The old people in the nursing home ＿＿ by volunteers every week.
q.e: 老人「被拜訪」，每週發生，用現在式被動 are visited。

q.q: 「這幅畫是誰畫的？」用被動語態怎麼問？
o: Who was this picture drawn by?
Who did this picture drawn by?
Who was this picture drew by?
Who this picture was drawn by?
q.e: 被動問句：Who＋was＋主詞＋過去分詞＋by?

q.q: 下列哪一句是被動語態？
o: The cake was eaten by the kids.
The kids are eating the cake.
The kids have eaten the cake.
q.e: be 動詞＋過去分詞，主詞 cake 是「被吃」的。

q.q: The book ＿＿ into Chinese last year.
q.e: 書「被翻譯」，去年發生，用 was translated。

q.q: 在孤兒院當志工時，下列哪一個行為最合適？
o: 拍下小朋友的照片隨意上傳
只在有空的時候才出現一下
q.e: 志工服務要尊重對方，並負責任地完成承諾。

q.q: The dog was trained ＿＿ people find their way.
q.e: be trained to＋原形動詞：被訓練來做某事。

q.q: 「這隻狗被一個男孩救了。」英文怎麼說？
o: The dog was saved by a boy.
The dog saved by a boy.
The dog was save by a boy.
A boy was saved by the dog.
q.e: 被動：was＋saved＋by 做動作的人。

q.q: Many lives ＿＿ by rescue dogs after the earthquake.
q.e: 生命「被拯救」，過去發生：were saved。

q.q: volunteer 這個字的意思是什麼？
q.e: volunteer 是志工，也可以當動詞「自願做」。

q.q: The hero dog ＿＿ a medal by the city.
q.e: 狗「被授予」獎牌：was given。

q.q: Our classroom ＿＿ every day.
q.e: 教室「被打掃」，每天發生，用現在式被動。

q.q: The concert ＿＿ because of the rain.
q.e: 音樂會「被取消」，用 was canceled。

q.q: The new library will ＿＿ next month.
q.e: 未來式被動：will be opened。

q.q: The problem has ＿＿ already.
q.e: 現在完成式被動：has been solved。

q.q: 把 They grow rice in this village. 改成被動語態，哪一個正確？
o: Rice is grown in this village.
Rice grows in this village by them.
Rice is grew in this village.
Rice was grow in this village.
q.e: grow 的過去分詞是 grown，主詞 rice 不可數，用 is。

q.q: The wallet ＿＿ on the bus yesterday.
q.e: 錢包「被找到」：was found。

q.q: —Who painted this picture? —It ＿＿ by my cousin.
q.e: 回答被誰畫的：It was painted by ...。

q.q: 下列哪一句文法正確？
o: The song was sung by a famous singer.
The song was sang by a famous singer.
The song sung by a famous singer was.
The song is sing by a famous singer.
q.e: sing 的過去分詞是 sung：sing－sang－sung。

units.title: Unit 4 Do You Know Where the File Is?

q.q: Do you know where ＿＿?
q.e: 名詞子句用直述句語序：疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞。

q.q: Can you tell me what time ＿＿?
q.e: 放在句子中間的問句要改成直述句語序：what time it is。

q.q: I don't know who ＿＿ that robot.
q.e: 疑問詞 who 本身是主詞時，後面直接接動詞。

q.q: Please tell me why ＿＿ late.
q.e: 名詞子句語序：why＋主詞 you＋動詞 were。

q.q: 把 Where does Ben live? 放進 I wonder ... 中，哪一個正確？
o: I wonder where does Ben live.
I wonder where did Ben live.
q.e: 去掉助動詞 does，動詞依主詞改成 lives。

q.q: Do you know how much ＿＿?
q.e: 去掉 does，動詞改成第三人稱單數 costs。

q.q: I don't know what ＿＿.
q.e: 疑問詞＋to＋原形動詞，表示「該怎麼……」。

q.q: Can you show me how ＿＿ this app?
q.e: how to use：如何使用。

q.q: I don't know where to go. 也可以怎麼說？
o: I don't know where I should go.
I don't know where should I go.
I don't know where I go to.
I don't know where to going.
q.e: 疑問詞＋to V＝疑問詞＋主詞＋should＋原形動詞。

q.q: Tell me when ＿＿ the robot vacuum.
q.e: when to turn on：何時打開。

q.q: He taught me ＿＿ to set the timer.
q.e: how to set：如何設定。

q.q: She can't decide which dress ＿＿.
q.e: which＋名詞＋to V：該穿哪一件。

q.q: I'm not sure ＿＿ the store is open today.
q.e: 表示「是否」，用 if 或 whether。

q.q: Ask Tim whether ＿＿ to the party.
q.e: whether 子句用直述句語序。

q.q: 把 Is the light on? 放進 Can you check ...? 中，哪一個正確？
o: Can you check if the light is on?
Can you check is the light on?
Can you check if is the light on?
Can you check what the light is on?
q.e: Yes／No 問句變名詞子句：if／whether＋主詞＋動詞。

q.q: I wonder ＿＿ or not.
q.e: 後面有 or not 時，常用 whether。

q.q: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home. 這句的 if 是什麼意思？
q.e: 這裡的 if 引導條件句，意思是「如果」。

q.q: Do you know if ＿＿ a robot at home?
q.e: if 子句用直述句語序，主詞 Ann 搭配 has。

q.q: 下列哪一個是比較禮貌的問法？
o: Could you tell me where the restroom is?
q.e: 間接問句 Could you tell me ... 語氣比較委婉禮貌。

q.q: 「你知道他住哪裡嗎？」英文怎麼說？
o: Do you know where he lives?
Do you know where does he live?
Do you know where he live?
Do you know where is he living?
q.e: 名詞子句語序，動詞配合主詞 he 用 lives。

q.q: I asked her ＿＿.
q.e: 主要子句是過去式，名詞子句也用過去式 wanted，語序是主詞＋動詞。

q.q: Can you tell me ＿＿ the meeting starts?
q.e: 問「什麼時候開始」用 when。

q.q: smart home 指的是什麼？
o: 可以用網路和裝置控制家電的住宅
q.e: 智慧住宅透過網路連接家電，可以用手機或語音控制。

q.q: 下列哪一句是錯的？
o: I don't know what is her name.
I don't know what her name is.
I don't know who she is.
I don't know where she works.
q.e: 名詞子句要用直述句語序，應該是 what her name is。

q.q: Do you know ＿＿ the meeting room is?
q.e: 問地點用 where，語序是 where＋主詞＋動詞。

q.q: I'm not sure ＿＿ I locked the door.
q.e: 不確定「是否」鎖了門：whether／if。

q.q: She asked me ＿＿ to plug in the charger.
q.e: where to plug in：該插在哪裡。

q.q: Could you tell me how ＿＿ to the MRT station?
q.e: how to get to：怎麼去。

q.q: Hey robot, tell me ＿＿ today.
q.e: 名詞子句語序：what＋the weather＋is like。

q.q: I don't remember who ＿＿ this message.
q.e: who 當主詞，後面直接接動詞，過去式 sent。

q.q: 把 Did Mom turn off the oven? 放進 I don't know ... 中，哪一個正確？
o: I don't know if Mom turned off the oven.
I don't know if did Mom turn off the oven.
I don't know Mom turned off the oven if.
I don't know whether Mom turn off the oven.
q.e: 去掉 did，動詞改回過去式 turned。

q.q: 使用語音助理時，下列哪一個做法比較能保護個人資料？
o: 不要說出密碼和身分證字號
q.e: 連網裝置可能記錄聲音，個人敏感資料不要隨便說出來。

units.title: Unit 5 The Man Who Shook Hands with Me Is My Favorite Star

q.q: The girl ＿＿ is my sister.
q.e: 介系詞片語 with long hair 放在名詞後面修飾 the girl。

q.q: The book on the desk ＿＿ mine.
q.e: 主詞是 The book（單數），on the desk 只是修飾，動詞用 is。

q.q: The boys in the classroom ＿＿ playing games.
q.e: 主詞是 The boys（複數），動詞用 are。

q.q: 「穿紅色外套的那個人是我的老師。」英文怎麼說？
o: The man in the red coat is my teacher.
The man is in the red coat my teacher.
In the red coat the man is my teacher.
The man in the red coat are my teacher.
q.e: in the red coat 放在 the man 後面修飾。

q.q: The cup ＿＿ the table is broken.
q.e: 杯子在桌「上」用 on。

q.q: The store near my house ＿＿ comic books.
q.e: 主詞 The store 單數，動詞加 s。

q.q: The man ＿＿ shook hands with me is my favorite star.
q.e: 先行詞是「人」，關係代名詞用 who（或 that）。

q.q: I have a friend who ＿＿ in Canada.
q.e: who 指 a friend（單數），動詞用 lives。

q.q: 把 I met a girl. + She can draw comics well. 合併，哪一個正確？
o: I met a girl who can draw comics well.
I met a girl who she can draw comics well.
I met a girl which can draw comics well.
I met a girl can draw comics well who.
q.e: 用 who 代替 she，連接兩句。

q.q: The students who ＿＿ the contest will get a prize.
q.e: who 指 students（複數），動詞用原形 win。

q.q: 「那個唱歌的女孩是我的同學。」英文怎麼說？
o: The girl who is singing is my classmate.
The girl who singing is my classmate.
The girl is singing who is my classmate.
The girl which is singing is my classmate.
q.e: who is singing 修飾 the girl。

q.q: People who ＿＿ comics often go to the comic expo.
q.e: 先行詞 People 是複數，動詞用 love。

q.q: This is the phone ＿＿ has a great camera.
q.e: 先行詞是「物」，用 which（或 that）。

q.q: A dictionary is a book that ＿＿ you the meanings of words.
q.e: that 指 a book（單數），動詞用 tells。

q.q: The bus ＿＿ goes to the zoo is No. 5.
q.e: 先行詞是物 the bus，用 that 或 which。

q.q: 「熊貓是一種吃竹子的動物。」英文怎麼說？
o: A panda is an animal which eats bamboo.
A panda is an animal who eat bamboo.
A panda is an animal eats bamboo.
A panda is an animal which eat bamboo.
q.e: which 指 an animal（單數），動詞加 s。

q.q: 下列哪一句的關係代名詞用錯了？
o: The book who is on the desk is mine.
The man who lives here is kind.
The car which is red is new.
The dog that barks is cute.
q.e: 書是物，要用 which 或 that，不能用 who。

q.q: The movie ＿＿ won the award is from Taiwan.
q.e: 先行詞是物 the movie，用 that 或 which。

q.q: What do you call a person who draws comics?
q.e: 畫漫畫的人叫 cartoonist（漫畫家）。

q.q: What do you call a person who writes books?
q.e: 寫書的人是 writer（作家）。

q.q: A fan is a person ＿＿ likes a star very much.
q.e: fan 是人，用 who。

q.q: The singer who ＿＿ in the concert last night is very popular.
q.e: 昨晚唱，用過去式 sang。

q.q: The man with glasses ＿＿ signing books now.
q.e: 主詞 The man 單數，正在簽名：is signing。

q.q: autograph 這個字的意思是什麼？
q.e: 向明星要的親筆簽名叫 autograph。

q.q: The boy ＿＿ is standing next to the door is my brother.
q.e: 先行詞是人，用 who。

q.q: The shoes that ＿＿ on sale are very cheap.
q.e: that 指 shoes（複數），動詞用 are。

q.q: The girl with the blue bag ＿＿ my cousin.
q.e: 主詞是 The girl（單數），with the blue bag 是修飾語。

q.q: 把 The comic book is very funny. + It is on the shelf. 合併，哪一個正確？
o: The comic book which is on the shelf is very funny.
The comic book is on the shelf which is very funny it.
The comic book who is on the shelf is very funny.
The comic book which it is on the shelf is very funny.
q.e: 用 which 代替 It，關係子句緊接在先行詞後面。

q.q: I like stories ＿＿ have happy endings.
q.e: 先行詞 stories 是物，用 that 或 which。

q.q: A pilot is a person who ＿＿ planes.
q.e: who 指 a person（單數），動詞用 flies。

q.q: The man who shook hands with me ＿＿ my favorite star.
q.e: 主詞是 The man（單數），中間的關係子句不影響動詞。

q.q: 下列哪一句是正確的？
o: The players who won the game are happy.
The players who won the game is happy.
The players which won the game are happy.
The players who wins the game are happy.
q.e: 先行詞是人用 who，主詞 players 複數用 are。

units.title: Unit 6 The Sign Which You Used Is Not OK

q.q: The sign which you used ＿＿ not OK in some countries.
q.e: 主詞是 The sign（單數），動詞用 is。

q.q: This is the dish ＿＿ my mom made.
q.e: 先行詞是物，用 which 或 that；這裡 which 當 made 的受詞。

q.q: The boy ＿＿ I met yesterday is from France.
q.e: 先行詞是人，在子句中當受詞，可以用 whom、who 或 that。

q.q: The bag (that) I bought ＿＿ very light.
q.e: 主詞 The bag 單數，動詞用 is。

q.q: 下列哪一句中的關係代名詞可以省略？
o: The movie that we watched was great.
The man who lives here is kind.
The dog which barks is mine.
The girl who won is happy.
q.e: 關係代名詞在子句中當「受詞」時可以省略；當主詞時不能省略。

q.q: 「這是我最喜歡的那首歌。」(用 which) 英文怎麼說？
o: This is the song which I like the most.
This is the song which I like it the most.
This is the song who I like the most.
This is the song I like it the most.
q.e: which 已經代替受詞，後面不能再加 it。

q.q: I have a friend ＿＿ father is a chef.
q.e: whose 表示「……的」，後面接名詞 father。

q.q: The girl whose bike ＿＿ stolen called the police.
q.e: whose bike 的 bike 是單數，被偷是過去：was stolen。

q.q: 把 I know a boy. + His sister is a singer. 合併，哪一個正確？
o: I know a boy whose sister is a singer.
I know a boy who sister is a singer.
I know a boy whose his sister is a singer.
I know a boy which sister is a singer.
q.e: 用 whose 代替 His。

q.q: This is the house ＿＿ roof is red.
q.e: whose 也可以指物：屋頂是紅色的房子。

q.q: The student whose ＿＿ are long is Mia.
q.e: whose 後面接名詞，複數 legs 搭配 are。

q.q: 「那位作品得獎的畫家很年輕。」英文怎麼說？
o: The painter whose work won a prize is young.
The painter who work won a prize is young.
The painter whose his work won a prize is young.
The painter which work won a prize is young.
q.e: whose work：他的作品。

q.q: I have two cats. One is white, and ＿＿ is black.
q.e: 兩個之中的另一個用 the other。

q.q: This cake is delicious. Can I have ＿＿ piece?
q.e: 再一個（不限定是哪一個）用 another。

q.q: Some students like math, and ＿＿ like English.
q.e: 一些……，另一些（其他人，不是全部）用 others。

q.q: There are five apples. I ate two, and my brother ate ＿＿.
q.e: 剩下的全部（特定的那些）用 the others。

q.q: Be kind to ＿＿.
q.e: others＝other people，別人。

q.q: I don't like this shirt. Please show me ＿＿ one.
q.e: 再給我看「另一件」：another one。

q.q: 到別的國家旅遊前，最好先做哪一件事？
o: 了解當地的文化和禁忌
學會用手勢表達所有事情
q.e: 不同國家的手勢、習俗意義可能不一樣，事先了解可以避免誤會。

q.q: 在法國，見面時常見的打招呼方式是什麼？
q.e: 法國人在熟人之間常用輕碰臉頰的方式打招呼，各地習慣不完全一樣。

q.q: The food ＿＿ you cooked smells great.
q.e: 先行詞是物 the food，用 that 或 which。

q.q: A culture shock is a feeling ＿＿ people have in a new culture.
q.e: 先行詞 a feeling 是物，用 which（或 that）。

q.q: The custom which they follow ＿＿ interesting.
q.e: 主詞 The custom 單數，動詞用 is。

q.q: 當外國朋友做了你看不懂的手勢時，比較好的反應是什麼？
q.e: 文化不同時，先詢問、理解，表現尊重。

q.q: The teacher ＿＿ we like the most is Mr. Lin.
q.e: 先行詞是人，在子句中當受詞，可以用 whom／who／that。

q.q: I met a woman ＿＿ son is a famous chef.
q.e: whose son：她的兒子。

q.q: Tom has three brothers. One is a doctor, and ＿＿ are teachers.
q.e: 三個中的一個以外，「剩下的全部」用 the others。

q.q: The gift which you gave me ＿＿ very useful.
q.e: 主詞 The gift 單數，動詞用 is。

q.q: 把 The dumplings were delicious. + We ate them last night. 合併，哪一個正確？
o: The dumplings which we ate last night were delicious.
The dumplings which we ate them last night were delicious.
The dumplings who we ate last night were delicious.
The dumplings were delicious which we ate them last night.
q.e: which 代替 them，子句中不能再出現 them。

q.q: Do you have ＿＿ question?
q.e: 再一個問題：another question。

q.q: The girl whose ＿＿ is Kiki is my neighbor.
q.e: whose dog 搭配單數 is。

q.q: 下列哪一句是正確的？
o: The movie we saw yesterday was exciting.
The movie we saw it yesterday was exciting.
The movie who we saw yesterday was exciting.
The movie we saw yesterday were exciting.
q.e: 受格關係代名詞可以省略；子句中不能再有 it；主詞 movie 單數用 was。

1.n: 現在完成式要用過去分詞。規則動詞加 ed，不規則動詞要一個一個記，例如 eat、ate、eaten，go、went、gone。
現在完成式是 have 或 has 加上過去分詞，可以說經驗、已經完成的事，或從過去持續到現在的事。
L: 完成：already（肯定）、yet（疑問、否定）
d: 肯定用 already，疑問、否定用 yet

1.n: for 接一段時間，since 接時間點或過去的子句。問持續多久用 How long。明確的過去時間，例如 yesterday，要用過去式。
L: have been to 去過；have gone to 去了還沒回來

2.n: 事物帶給人的感覺用 -ing，例如 exciting。人自己的感受用 -ed，例如 excited。
look、sound、smell、taste、feel 後面直接接形容詞；如果要接名詞，要加 like。
d: 接名詞要加 like：It sounds like a song.

2.n: 形容詞加 enough to 是夠怎樣可以做某事；too 加形容詞再加 to 是太怎樣而不能。so 加形容詞再加 that 子句，表示結果。
L: so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句
d: too tired to go（太累，不能去）
old enough to drive（夠大，可以開車）

3.n: 被動語態是 be 動詞加過去分詞，表示主詞被怎麼樣。做動作的人放在 by 後面。
L: The soldier was saved by a dog.
主動句的受詞 → 被動句的主詞
d: 被動：be 動詞 ＋ 過去分詞

3.n: 被動語態也有不同時態。未來式是 will be 加過去分詞；助動詞也是加 be；現在完成式是 have been 加過去分詞。
當志工要尊重服務的對象，準時並完成承諾。到養老院或孤兒院服務時，要先了解規定。

4.n: 把疑問句放進另一個句子裡，要改成直述句語序，也就是疑問詞加主詞再加動詞，助動詞 do、does、did 要去掉。
L: Do you know where the file is?
疑問詞 ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞
d: 疑問詞 ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞

4.n: 疑問詞後面可以直接接 to 加原形動詞，意思是該怎麼做，等於疑問詞加主詞加 should。
L: where to go ＝ where I should go

4.n: Yes 或 No 的問句放進句子裡，用 whether 或 if 開頭，意思是是否。後面有 or not 時常用 whether。注意 if 也可以當如果。
L: I wonder whether it will rain or not.
if 也可以是「如果」
d: I wonder if it will rain.
If it rains, we will stay home.

5.n: 介系詞片語可以放在名詞後面修飾它。找動詞時要看真正的主詞，不要被中間的片語騙了。
L: The girl with long hair is my sister.
The book on the desk is mine.

5.n: 先行詞是人用 who，是物用 which，兩種都可以用 that。關係代名詞當主詞時，後面的動詞要配合先行詞的單複數，而且不能省略。
L: a friend who lives in Canada
d: 動詞|配合先行詞的單複數

6.n: 關係代名詞在子句中當受詞時，人可以用 whom、who、that，物用 which、that，而且可以省略。子句裡不能再出現它代替的那個受詞。
L: The sign (which) you used is not OK.
當受詞時可以省略

6.n: whose 表示誰的或它的，後面一定接名詞，人和物都可以用。
L: I have a friend whose father is a chef.

6.n: another 是再一個；the other 是兩者中的另一個；others 是其他的一些；the others 是剩下的全部。
L: others 一些別的；the others 剩下全部
